lead_summary.zh: 白宮幕僚長換米勒；台股重挫1,873點
lead_summary.en: Miller named chief of staff; TAIEX sinks 1,873

title.zh: 米勒接任白宮幕僚長　懷爾斯轉任政治團隊
title.en: Stephen Miller named chief of staff, replacing Susie Wiles

body.zh: 美國總統川普 6 日在社群平台宣布，由副幕僚長米勒接替懷爾斯出任白宮幕僚長，9 日（週一）起生效，懷爾斯將轉往川普的政治組織任職；川普稱米勒是他最信任的顧問之一，並感謝懷爾斯的貢獻。懷爾斯在 X 發文表示，為總統效力是一生的榮幸。這是共和黨在期中選舉失去國會多數後，白宮首度出現的重大人事異動；米勒長期主導川普的移民與邊境政策，外界預期民主黨明年 1 月掌控國會後可能對他展開調查。
body.en: President Donald Trump announced on social media on the 6th that deputy chief of staff Stephen Miller will replace Susie Wiles as White House chief of staff from Monday, the 9th, with Wiles moving to Trump's political operation; Trump called Miller one of his most trusted advisers and thanked Wiles for her work. Wiles wrote on X that serving the president had been the honor of a lifetime. It is the first major White House personnel change since Republicans lost their congressional majorities in the midterms; Miller has long driven Trump's immigration and border policy, and Democrats are widely expected to investigate him once they take control of Congress in January.

title.zh: 巴拉圭參院罷免潘尼亞　副總統可望接任

body.zh: 路透報導，巴拉圭參議院 6 日表決將總統潘尼亞免職，起因是與他有商業往來的數位銀行 ueno 倒閉，導致大批存戶無法動用帳戶。潘尼亞 5 日已宣布請辭，但國會未通過接受辭職，隨即啟動彈劾程序。據《聯合報》引述當地媒體，副總統阿里亞納可望接任至任期屆滿，並預料延續與台灣的邦交；外交部政務次長陳明祺表示，政府密切關注情勢，並與巴國執政黨保持良好聯繫。
body.en: Paraguay's Senate voted on the 6th to remove President Santiago Peña from office, Reuters reported, over his ties to ueno, a digital bank whose collapse left large numbers of customers unable to reach their accounts. Peña had announced his resignation on the 5th, but Congress did not accept it and moved ahead with impeachment. Citing local media, UDN reported that Vice President Pedro Alliana is expected to serve out the term and to keep diplomatic ties with Taiwan; Taiwan's Deputy Foreign Minister Chen Ming-chi said the government is watching closely and keeps good contact with Paraguay's ruling party.

title.zh: 川普與卡達元首通話　討論美伊降溫斡旋
title.en: Trump and Qatar's emir discuss easing US-Iran tensions

body.zh: 據卡達埃米爾府發布的消息，卡達元首塔米姆 6 日與川普通話，討論區域局勢降溫及卡達居中斡旋、促成全面協議的努力，塔米姆強調持續對話，並呼籲確保航行自由與能源供應安全。川普前一天表示，期中選舉結束後將決定是否恢復軍事行動，並稱美國可能必須摧毀伊朗剩下的部分。路透引述伊朗官員指出，伊朗已透過卡達向美方遞交核議題提案，但要求美方先回應其重開荷莫茲海峽的 7 項條件；伊朗革命衛隊另稱在格什姆島上空擊落 2 架美國無人機。
body.en: Qatar's Emir Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani spoke with Trump on the 6th about regional de-escalation and Doha's mediation toward a comprehensive deal, according to the Emiri Diwan; the emir stressed continued dialogue and called for freedom of navigation and secure energy supplies. A day earlier, Trump said he would decide whether to resume military action now that the midterms are over, and said the US may have to destroy the rest of Iran. An Iranian official told Reuters that Tehran has sent a nuclear proposal through Qatar but wants Washington first to meet its seven conditions for reopening the Strait of Hormuz; Iran's Revolutionary Guards separately said they downed two US drones over Qeshm Island.

title.zh: 歐洲再現炸彈恐嚇潮　航班與媒體受波及
title.en: New wave of bomb threats hits European flights and newsrooms

body.zh: 歐洲 6 日再出現一波炸彈恐嚇，捷克警方登記 9 架進出布拉格的航班受威脅，法國也有 4 架飛越領空的班機收到恐嚇，均安全落地；匈牙利出動戰機護航客機，丹麥哥本哈根機場則維持正常運作。愛爾蘭國家廣播公司 RTÉ 收到電郵後短暫疏散員工，英國天空新聞與保加利亞 Nova 電視台也收到威脅。愛爾蘭政府表示幕後者身分不明，但看來是有組織的干擾行動；本週稍早已有數十架航班受影響，目前尚未發現爆裂物。
body.en: A new wave of bomb threats swept Europe on the 6th: Czech police logged threats against nine flights to or from Prague, and four aircraft over France received threats, all landing safely; Hungary scrambled jets to escort airliners, while Copenhagen airport kept operating normally. Ireland's broadcaster RTÉ briefly evacuated staff after an emailed threat, and Sky News in the UK and Bulgaria's Nova TV also received threats. The Irish government said it was unclear who was responsible but that it appeared to be a coordinated campaign of disruption; dozens of flights were affected earlier in the week, and no explosives have been found.

title.zh: 納吉居家服刑喊卡　大馬總檢署稱待釐清
title.en: Malaysia halts Najib's move to house arrest

body.zh: 馬來西亞吉隆坡高等法院 6 日在前首相納吉繳清 5,000 萬令吉罰款後，下令依有條件特赦讓他返家服刑至 2028 年 8 月 23 日。總檢察署隨即表示，特赦條件存在兩種解讀，繳罰款後是否仍須服刑、以及對一馬發展公司案刑期的影響都不明確，屬「複雜且前所未有」的法律問題，因此主張暫緩執行、維持他現有的羈押狀態。總檢察署強調並非挑戰元首的特赦令。
body.en: Kuala Lumpur's High Court ordered on the 6th that former prime minister Najib Razak, having paid a RM50 million fine, be released to serve the rest of his term under house arrest until August 23, 2028, under a conditional royal pardon. The Attorney General's Chambers quickly said the pardon can be read two ways, leaving it unclear whether paying the fine ends his prison term and how that affects his 1MDB sentence, calling the issues legally complex and unprecedented and urging that the transfer be postponed and his detention left unchanged. The AGC stressed it was not challenging the royal pardon.

title.zh: 金管會祭限空令等5措施　11/9起實施
title.en: FSC curbs short selling with five measures from Nov 9

body.zh: 台股重挫後，金管會 6 日宣布自 9 日（週一）起實施 5 項穩定股市措施：盤中借券賣出上限由 30 日均量的 30% 降至 3%，融券保證金成數由 90% 調高至 130%，放寬融資追繳可用其他具流動性資產補繳，並鼓勵上市櫃公司評估買回庫藏股、召開法說會與投資人溝通。金管會表示，近期波動源於國際政經情勢，將視情況適時調整措施，並提醒投資人理性因應。
body.en: After the market plunge, the Financial Supervisory Commission announced on the 6th five stabilization measures effective Monday, the 9th: the intraday securities-lending sell cap falls from 30% to 3% of 30-day average volume, the short-sale margin requirement rises from 90% to 130%, investors may meet margin calls with other liquid assets, and listed companies are encouraged to consider share buybacks and hold investor briefings. The FSC said recent volatility stems from international political and economic conditions, that it will adjust the measures as needed, and urged investors to respond rationally.

title.zh: 美10月新增16.5萬就業　升息壓力升高
title.en: US adds 165,000 jobs in October, raising hike pressure

body.zh: 美國勞工統計局 6 日公布，10 月非農就業增加 16.5 萬人，遠高於市場預估，失業率降至 4.1%，薪資月增 0.4%。聯準會 9 月已升息一碼，為 2023 年以來首度升息；根據 CME FedWatch，市場預估 12 月再升息一碼的機率約 68%。數據公布後美國十年期公債殖利率升至約 4.86%。
body.en: The Bureau of Labor Statistics reported on the 6th that nonfarm payrolls rose 165,000 in October, far above forecasts, while the unemployment rate fell to 4.1% and wages rose 0.4% from September. The Fed raised rates a quarter point in September, its first hike since 2023, and CME FedWatch put the odds of another quarter-point hike in December at about 68%. The 10-year Treasury yield rose to about 4.86% after the data.

title.zh: 日股跌入熊市　韓股盤中觸發熔斷
title.en: Nikkei enters bear market; Kospi triggers circuit breaker

body.zh: 美國科技股前一晚重挫，亞股 6 日全面走弱：日經 225 指數跌 3,643.13 點、收 57,434.77 點，跌幅 5.96%，為史上第三大單日跌點，較 6 月 25 日高點回落逾兩成，進入技術性熊市。南韓 KOSPI 盤中一度跌逾 8%、跌破 5,000 點，觸發 20 分鐘熔斷，終場跌 6.02% 收 5,059.65 點，SK 海力士跌逾 10%、三星電子跌 6.35%。市場憂心民主黨掌控國會後 AI 監管趨嚴、資料中心建置放緩，軟銀集團與鎧俠等 AI 概念股跌幅居前。
body.en: Asian markets slid on the 6th after the overnight US tech rout: the Nikkei 225 fell 3,643.13 points, or 5.96%, to 57,434.77, its third-largest one-day point drop, leaving it more than 20% below its June 25 high and in a bear market. South Korea's Kospi dropped more than 8% and below 5,000 intraday, triggering a 20-minute trading halt, before closing down 6.02% at 5,059.65, with SK Hynix off more than 10% and Samsung Electronics 6.35% lower. Investors worried that a Democratic-controlled Congress would tighten AI rules and slow data center construction, and AI-linked names such as SoftBank Group and Kioxia led the losses.

title.zh: 傳台積電研擬生產3D DRAM　應輝達要求
title.en: TSMC reportedly drafting 3D DRAM plan at Nvidia's request

body.zh: 據科技媒體 The Information 報導、鉅亨網引述，台積電應最大客戶輝達要求，近期開始研擬 3D DRAM 生產計畫，正評估興建新廠或收購既有廠房改建為記憶體產線，由先進封裝技術暨服務副總經理徐國晉主導。報導指計畫仍在草擬階段，量產時程未明；台積電與輝達均未回應置評。AI 硬體需求帶動記憶體嚴重短缺、價格攀升，輝達正尋求更多供應來源。
body.en: TSMC has recently begun drafting a plan to produce 3D DRAM at the request of its largest customer, Nvidia, according to The Information as cited by Anue, weighing either a new fab or buying an existing site to convert into a memory line, with advanced packaging vice president Xu Guo-jin leading the effort. The report said the plan is still being drafted and the production timeline is unclear; neither TSMC nor Nvidia responded to requests for comment. Surging AI hardware demand has caused severe memory shortages and rising prices, and Nvidia is looking for more supply sources.

title.zh: 傳微軟停租甲骨文AI算力　甲骨文股挫
title.en: Microsoft reportedly winds down Oracle AI compute deal

body.zh: 彭博引述消息人士報導，微軟正逐步結束 2023 年向甲骨文租用 AI 運算能力的合約，不再續約並已陸續關閉相關容量，原因是這些伺服器使用的輝達晶片較舊、已不符需求。微軟拒絕置評，甲骨文則表示其 AI 基礎設施需求依然強勁，包括舊款晶片在內；甲骨文股價應聲下跌約 3%。報導指出，微軟已承諾向 CoreWeave 等業者租用逾 800 億美元算力，近期也放棄部分擴充選項。
body.en: Microsoft is winding down a 2023 deal to rent AI computing capacity from Oracle, declining to renew it and switching off the rented capacity, Bloomberg reported citing people familiar, because the servers run older Nvidia chips that no longer fit its needs. Microsoft declined to comment, while Oracle said demand for its AI infrastructure remains strong, including for older chips; Oracle shares fell about 3%. Microsoft has committed more than US$80 billion to rent capacity from providers such as CoreWeave and recently passed on some expansion options, the report said.

headline.zh: 台股重挫1,873點失守4萬　盤中曾跌3,737點

body.zh: 加權指數 6 日大幅跳空開低 2,658.96 點，盤中最低來到 37,837.05 點、一度大跌 3,737.67 點，為史上最大盤中跌點，隨後跌幅收斂，終場跌 1,873.08 點收 39,701.64 點、失守 4 萬點，為史上第 4 大收盤跌點、連續第 7 個交易日下跌，成交值 1 兆 2,461.04 億元；櫃買指數跌 5.43%。台積電開盤即跌停至 2,020 元，終場收 2,135 元、跌 4.69%，鴻海跌 4.47%、聯發科跌 2.02%、台達電跌 6.64%、日月光投控跌 7.87%，信驊跌停；上市個股 106 家上漲、976 家下跌、27 家持平。美股前一晚重挫、日韓股市同步大跌，加上融資斷頭與外資賣壓，拖累盤勢；行政院長卓榮泰表示已指示金管會密切關注並視需要採取穩定措施，盤中承接買盤進場，跌幅隨之縮小。
body.en: The TAIEX gapped down 2,658.96 points at the open on the 6th and hit an intraday low of 37,837.05, down as much as 3,737.67 points, the largest intraday point drop on record, before paring losses to close down 1,873.08 points at 39,701.64, below 40,000, the fourth-largest closing point drop on record and a seventh straight losing session, on turnover of NT$1.246 trillion; the TPEx index fell 5.43%. TSMC opened limit-down at NT$2,020 and closed at NT$2,135, down 4.69%, while Hon Hai lost 4.47%, MediaTek 2.02%, Delta 6.64% and ASE 7.87%, and ASPEED hit limit-down; among listed stocks 106 rose, 976 fell and 27 were unchanged. A steep overnight US selloff, parallel slides in Japan and Korea, forced margin selling and foreign outflows weighed on the market; Premier Cho Jung-tai said he had told the FSC to watch closely and take stabilizing steps as needed, and bargain buying narrowed the losses during the session.

flows_note.zh: 投信買超主要集中台積電；上市櫃融資餘額合計單日大減 564.18 億元。
flows_note.en: Investment trusts' buying centered on TSMC; combined margin loans on listed and OTC stocks fell by NT$56.418 billion in a day.

headline.zh: 美股11/6：費半反彈4.21%　道瓊續跌237點
headline.en: US close, Nov 6: SOX rebounds 4.21%; Dow slips 237

body.zh: 前一日 AI 股大逃殺後，部分資金逢低承接，晶片股領軍反彈，費半漲 4.21%，AMD 漲 11%、英特爾漲 7.71%、美光漲 5.12%、輝達漲 2.78%，台積電 ADR 漲 6.33% 收 375.44 美元，那斯達克與標普 500 收高，道瓊則續跌 237.33 點。10 月非農就業大增 16.5 萬人、遠優於預期，市場評估聯準會 12 月升息的可能性，十年期美債殖利率升至約 4.86%；市場仍擔心民主黨掌控國會後資料中心建置放緩，布蘭特原油則跌破每桶 100 美元。
body.en: After the previous day's AI rout, some investors bought the dip and chipmakers led a rebound: the SOX rose 4.21%, with AMD up 11%, Intel 7.71%, Micron 5.12% and Nvidia 2.78%, and the TSMC ADR gained 6.33% to US$375.44; the Nasdaq and S&P 500 closed higher, while the Dow slipped another 237.33 points. October payrolls jumped 165,000, far above expectations, as markets weighed a possible December Fed hike and the 10-year Treasury yield rose to about 4.86%; worries persisted that a Democratic-controlled Congress could slow data center construction, and Brent crude fell below US$100 a barrel.

text.en: Israeli President Herzog due to name who will form the next government
